仙本那核心礁区珊瑚监测最新动态: Semporna core reef: latest coral monitoring
仙本那核心礁区（4.4°N, 118.8°E）最新一轮 AI 水下识别显示：活珊: The latest AI underwater survey at the Semporna core reef (4.4°N, 118.8°E) puts live coral cover at 39.71% — within 0.15 points of the 39.56% regional average from Reef Check Malaysia's 2024 field survey.
同期 NOAA 5km 热压力档案显示：2024 年 DHW 峰值 5.42，官: The NOAA 5 km heat-stress record for the same period shows a 2024 DHW peak of 5.42 with an official bleaching alert level of 1 — one of only 3 years in the past 41 to reach bleaching alert.
• 继续按季度做 AI 水下识别监测，跟踪覆盖率与白化比例的长期趋势: • Keep running quarterly AI underwater surveys to track cover and bleaching trends
• 把 NOAA 热压力档案纳入投放窗口决策，优先选择热压力更低的月份作业: • Factor the NOAA heat-stress record into deployment windows, working in the cooler months
仙本那海水热压力速览：41 年档案与 2024 年峰值: Semporna heat stress at a glance: a 41-year record and the 2024 peak
仙本那点位（4.4°N, 118.8°E）的 NOAA CRW 5km 档案覆盖: The NOAA CRW 5 km record for the Semporna site (4.4°N, 118.8°E) spans 41 years (1985–2025), logging HotSpot, DHW and the official Bleaching Alert Area level year by year.
2024 年 DHW 峰值 5.42，全年有 58 天达到 DHW≥4，是该点位: In 2024 the DHW peaked at 5.42 with 58 days at DHW≥4 — one of the three hottest years in the site's 41-year record, rated bleaching alert level 1.
• HotSpot 是瞬时海温异常（当下比常年高多少℃），DHW 是 12 周滚: • HotSpot is the instantaneous anomaly (how many °C above normal right now), DHW is the 12-week rolling accumulation, and BAA is the official alert level
• 触发白化的门槛是「比夏季最高月均温高 1℃ 并持续数周」，所以看累积量比只看: • Bleaching is triggered by water about 1 °C above the summer maximum for weeks, so the accumulation matters more than any single-day peak
• 5km 格点只回答「哪片海」，回答不了「哪个礁」——礁级判断仍要靠水下识别: • A 5 km grid tells you which patch of sea, not which reef — reef-level judgement still needs underwater surveys
仙本那的季风窗口：热压力什么时候回落: Semporna seasonal window: when heat stress eases
仙本那属热带季风气候，11–2 月东北季风期的海况与热压力通常相对缓和，是投放种: Semporna has a tropical monsoon climate; sea conditions and heat stress are usually milder during the north-east monsoon from November to February, making it the preferred window for out-planting.
把 NOAA 逐日 DHW 档案与投放计划对齐后，本项目的做法是：优先在热压力回: By aligning the daily NOAA DHW record with the deployment plan, we out-plant during the easing window and avoid the DHW climb.
